topics.text: The hotel offers a wide range of facilities, including private hot springs, game rooms, and barbecue areas. Guests enjoy the comprehensive amenities such as spacious rooms with large windows, private baths, and well-stocked toiletries.

Cleanliness is consistently praised, with guests noting the well-maintained rooms and fresh, pleasant atmosphere throughout the property. The emphasis on hygiene makes for a comfortable and relaxing stay.

The breakfast receives high marks for its variety and quality, with offerings that include healthy and beautifully presented options. Guests also appreciate the complimentary coffee and snacks provided during their stay.

The hotel is recommended for family visits, with amenities that cater to children and spacious accommodations. The environment is described as safe and enjoyable for families, with plenty of activities available.
